summary: Sultan Qaboos University in Muscat, Oman, offers two scholarships a year for international students who come from outside Oman to do a Master's degree. It is a full-time award open to all colleges and majors. The scholarship exempts tuition and pays a monthly allowance of 250 OMR, and the page adds an annual economy flight. There is no separate scholarship application: students apply for admission, and the university nominates from among those admitted without conditions.
eligibility_notes:
Who the scholarship is for: international students who come from outside the Sultanate to study and do not live in Oman. The cohort is made up of students who are admitted unconditionally and who meet the general scholarship conditions that year. The scholarship has been renewed every year since 2018.

General scholarship conditions: unconditional admission to the programme applied for; for a Master's, a cumulative undergraduate GPA of at least 3.00 out of 4.00 (or equivalent); full-time study.

The scholarship is open in all colleges and all majors, and only for full-time study. The number of places is two, both at Master's level.

Admission rules that apply before any scholarship: the university uses a four-point grading scale and decides itself how foreign qualifications and GPA are equivalent. The minimum admission GPA for a Master's is 2.75 (2.50 with work experience), but the scholarship asks for 3.00. Qualifications obtained outside Oman must carry an attestation certificate issued by the Ministry of Education before the first semester starts.

English: a valid IELTS Academic or TOEFL iBT certificate is required for programmes taught in English or in English and Arabic. For a Master's, the score needed is the one set by the programme. A person whose mother tongue is English is exempt. An application is cancelled if the English certificate is not attached.

A person dismissed from a postgraduate programme must wait two years from the dismissal date before applying again.
age_experience_notes: The pages read state no age limit. Work experience is not required for the scholarship; it only lowers the minimum admission GPA from 2.75 to 2.50.
funding_summary: The scholarship exempts the tuition fee, including fees for probation periods and repeated courses, and pays a monthly allowance of 250 OMR to Master's students. The page also lists an annual two-way economy class ticket to the airport nearest the student's permanent home. Application fees and bridging courses are not covered. The pages read do not state how many years of funding a Master's student receives.
programmes_note: The scholarship is open in all colleges and all majors, full-time Master's only. The university runs programmes in nine colleges: Economic and Political Science, Education, Arts and Social Sciences, Engineering, Agricultural and Marine Science, Science, Medicine and Health Sciences, Law, and Nursing. The programme list below is partial; the full list is on the postgraduate programmes page, which spreads over several pages.
institutions_note: The only host is Sultan Qaboos University in Muscat. The international scholarship is one of seven scholarship categories run by the Deanship of Postgraduate Studies; the others (for example places for Ministry of Education staff, Palestinian passport holders, SQU staff and Ministry of Defense nominees) have their own nominating bodies and do not apply to this award.

summary.detail: Two places a year, full-time, all colleges and majors, for students from outside Oman who do not live there. Needs unconditional admission and an undergraduate GPA of at least 3.00 out of 4.00 (or equivalent). Benefits: tuition exemption and a monthly allowance of 250 OMR. Teaching language is not stated on the scholarship page; English-taught programmes need IELTS Academic or TOEFL iBT at the programme's set score.

requirements.text: Personal documents: passport, ID or residence card, and a photo. Applicants living outside Oman enter a passport number and its expiry date in the application form. Uploads must be JPG or PDF.
Certified academic certificates: the bachelor's certificate, plus a higher diploma or postgraduate certificate if the applicant has one.

Attestation certificate from the Ministry of Education for qualifications obtained outside Oman, requested through the ministry; the qualification must also be assessed for equivalency before the first semester.
requirements.conditional_rule: Only for qualifications obtained outside Oman

requirements.text: Official academic transcripts for the bachelor's degree, and for a higher diploma or postgraduate certificate if any.
English proficiency certificate: IELTS Academic or TOEFL iBT only, valid on the day the application is submitted, with the score set by the programme. Native English speakers are exempt.
requirements.conditional_rule: Exempt if the mother tongue is English

requirements.text: Study leave or employer approval letter, as listed in the document table for Master's applicants. The page does not explain who must provide it.
Applicants funded by an outside sponsor must give a funding letter to the Tuition Fees Department.

application_steps.title: Read the programme requirements and prepare documents
application_steps.detail: Check the requirements of the Master's programme you want on the Postgraduate Studies site. Prepare the documents listed for Master's applicants, including an IELTS Academic or TOEFL iBT certificate that will still be valid on the day you apply. Qualifications from outside Oman need an attestation certificate from the Ministry of Education.

application_steps.title: Submit the admission application online as an international applicant
application_steps.detail: Apply through the university's student information system, accept the declaration, and fill in the form: choose 'International' as nationality, enter passport details and expiry date, programme choice, qualifications, English certificate, supporting documents and work experience. You may apply to more than one programme in one form (not Law), subject to exam and interview schedules. You receive a confirmation email on submission.

application_steps.title: Pay the application fee and track your status
application_steps.detail: The non-refundable fee is 10 Omani Rials per programme. The application cannot be changed once the fee is paid, and incomplete applications are not considered. Follow your status in the applicant portal during the application period. There is no separate scholarship application.

application_steps.title: Admission evaluation by the Deanship and the college
application_steps.detail: The Deanship checks general eligibility, then the college admission committee assesses the application against approved criteria. Some programmes require exams or interviews. Notifications are issued once all evaluation steps are approved. Admission can be conditional or unconditional; the scholarship needs unconditional admission.

application_steps.title: Automatic nomination for the international scholarship
application_steps.detail: Admitted students are considered automatically. The university's nomination process is: approve the yearly distribution, colleges set selection criteria, admitted applicants who meet the conditions are ranked and nominated, the Deputy Vice Chancellor approves the nominees, and an offer is sent. The International Students Section handles nomination for this scholarship.

application_steps.title: Accept the offer and confirm through registration
application_steps.detail: The nominee accepts or rejects the offer, then goes through an initial confirmation and a final confirmation linked to registration. Admitted students must activate their university account, register and choose courses within the academic calendar dates.

application_steps.title: Sign the scholarship contract in week four
application_steps.detail: The scholarship contract is signed in the fourth week of study. The scholarship commitments follow the Postgraduate Scholarship Guidelines.

application_steps.title: Apply for the university-sponsored visa
application_steps.detail: Newly admitted students outside Oman with no current visa complete and sign the visa application form, collect the supporting documents it lists, combine everything into one PDF with the form first, and email it to the International Students Section. Visa and residence procedures follow the Royal Oman Police expatriate visa laws.

application_steps.title: Meet the scholarship obligations
application_steps.detail: Stay full-time for the whole programme. Work no more than 10 hours a week for a full scholarship, as assigned by the department head. Full scholarships include 36 working days of paid leave, with the head's approval. The scholarship can be suspended (for example for not registering, poor performance or postponing after the first semester) or terminated (for example for withdrawing or breaching full-time or contract terms); a terminated scholarship cannot be reinstated.
